note: The party for one session, as player character sheets. tools/build-session-party.py reads this file: a member with `reuse` already has a character sheet in the world mirror and is only reported; every other member is built as a dnd5e character into actors/<packet>/ from `base` (an NPC statblock the archive already has), keeping its kit and art. Levels without a ledger row are the GM's call; every assumption is written into the sheet's biography. Not on players.roster: these sheets are for this session, not the standing party.

members.name: Mr. T
assumptions: Rogue (Thief) read off the record: the courier who moves fast, keeps records and has a sense for coin.
Level 5, the party's level (Waluigi 5, Wario 6); Mr. T has no XP ledger row.
Standard array: DEX 15, INT 14, WIS 13, CON 12, STR 10, CHA 8.
Saving throws DEX and INT (Rogue); skills Stealth, Sleight of Hand, Investigation, Perception (class), Athletics, Insight (background).

members.name: Beta Luigi
assumptions: Warlock (Archfey Patron) read off the record: the ghost-touched brother of the Feywild House, with a withering touch and an incorporeal step.
Level 5, the party's level; Beta Luigi has no XP ledger row.
Standard array: CHA 15, DEX 14, CON 13, WIS 12, INT 10, STR 8.
Spells and invocations are the player's to pick in Foundry; Withering Touch and Incorporeal Movement are kept as features from the statblock.

members.name: Jory Dobbs
assumptions: Fighter (Champion) read off the record: hired off a noticeboard, swings a club, loud, light-fingered.
Level 3, as his record's ledger line gives it.
Standard array: STR 15, CON 14, DEX 13, CHA 12, WIS 10, INT 8.
The world's Jory Dobbs NPC statblock stays as it is; this is a second, player-run sheet.
